direction.name: The Light Finder
direction.thesis: A panoramic sky window supports the decision to go outside, followed by a local-time ruler and seven-day comparison.
direction.audience: Everyday sunset watchers; photography detail is secondary.

effects.gradients: structural only: rules, ruler ticks, and viewfinder corners

typography.numericStyle: tabular numerals for scores, times, rulers, measurements, and tables

breakpoints.behavior: Narrow single-column fallback; score and verdict share a row; light details stack; centered locate icon is hidden.
Mobile stack; timing precedes the forecast panorama; seven-day row scrolls and snaps; metrics use two columns.
24px gutters with mobile composition. CSS exposes the mobile search trigger through 767px; JavaScript opens its full-screen sheet at 700px and below.
Tablet composition; seven-day row spans the page; score stays beside the message; explanation and summary stats align in a wide row.
Compact desktop two-column dashboard with compressed gaps and type.
Full desktop composition with 4vw gutters and all seven days visible.
62px gutters and centered 1412px maximum content width.
Top spacing and panorama heights compress before text size.

shared.footer: thin top rule, wordmark, and utility links

landing: question and search split across two columns on desktop
forecast: place/date and plain-language forecast beside score/verdict
golden-hour interval, ruler, and sunset strip
seven-day outlook beside explanation on desktop
SEO forecast summary and table after the interactive dashboard when present

panorama.landingHeight: clamp(240px, 27vw, 380px); 240px on mobile; 180px on short screens
panorama.forecastHeight: clamp(230px, 21.2vw, 326px); 200px on mobile; 170px on short screens
panorama.frame: white 22px by 1px corner marks inset 20px desktop and 14px mobile
panorama.caption: Illustrative sky, not a live view or a prediction.

search.submit: Find resolves a chosen suggestion or forward-geocodes text, then navigates to its canonical place path.
search.suggestions: Begin after two typed characters, show up to six Photon results, and support ArrowUp, ArrowDown, Enter, Escape, click, and outside-click dismissal.
search.loading: Find becomes Reading; find and location controls are disabled; live status announces progress or errors.
search.approximateLocation: IP-derived place can prefill without a permission prompt when the user has not edited the field.
search.preciseLocation: Browser geolocation is requested only after explicit activation, reverse-geocoded, then searched.
search.mobile: Forecast header search is presented as a full-screen fixed sheet at supported small widths.

interactions.daySelection: Updates score, message, times, ruler, explanation, and metrics together; uses aria-pressed; restores focus to the selected day.
interactions.photographyDetails: Native details/summary disclosure; plus icon rotates 45 degrees when open.

motion.scrollBehavior: smooth unless reduced motion is requested

semantics: native forms, buttons, details, and summary
accessibility.focus: 3px solid focus token with 4px offset; search shell also marks focus-within
accessibility.targets: Primary interactive controls are at least 44px; theme toggle is 48px square.
accessibility.selectedState: Active day uses aria-pressed, fill, and typography in addition to color.
accessibility.imageAlternative: Panorama alt text describes amber evening clouds over an ocean horizon; the caption disclaims live or predictive meaning.
accessibility.reducedMotion: prefers-reduced-motion disables animation, transitions, and smooth scrolling

assets.provenance: Project-generated sunset panorama derived from the approved Light Finder direction.
assets.usageConstraint: Always label as illustrative, not live or predictive.
